topPRs.title: feat: add Whitechain Sepolia Testnet
topPRs.author: donoso-eth
topPRs.body:
> **Do not merge until #1399 and the matching monorepo PR are merged.** This config sets `minBaseFee`, which the registry schema only models after #1399 (this branch is stacked on it — the diff shrinks to the two staging files once it lands). Promoting it before the monorepo models the field would fail `TestAllEmbeddedConfigsDecodeStrictly` on the next pin bump. See #1398.

Adds Whitechain Sepolia Testnet (chain ID 1874) to the registry.

| | |
|---|---|
| Chain ID | 1874 |
| Superchain | sepolia |
| Contracts | op-contracts/v6.0.0 (L1 + L2), permissioned games only |
| DA | eth-da |
| Block time | 1s |
| Gas limit | 40,000,000 |
| Genesis `minBaseFee` | 5 gwei (Jovian at genesis) |
| Governed by Optimism | no |
| Public RPC | https://rpc.testnet.whitechain.io |
| Explorer | https://explorer.testnet.whitechain.io |

### Verified against chain

- **L2 genesis**: hash `0xb92575f4…`, L1 origin 11071328 (`0x6a6d405d…`), batcher, packed scalar (1368 / 801949) and gas limit all match the staged config. Genesis artifact round-trips byte-identically.
- **`minBaseFee`**: `SystemConfig.minBaseFee()` reads `5000000000` on L1, and the L2's `extraData` carries it from block 1 onward (block 0 has `0`, so it's the genesis system config, not a later `ConfigUpdate`).
- **Roles and addresses**: `SystemConfig` owner/batcher/unsafe-signer and all six contract getters, `OptimismPortal.guardian()`, `ProxyAdmin.owner()`, and the proposer/challenger/vm/weth decoded from `DisputeGameFactory.gameArgs(1)` all match. `respectedGameType = 1`; no permissionless game registered.
- **Contract versions**: every proxy reports its v6.0.0 standard version (SystemConfig 3.13.1, Portal 5.2.0, DGF 1.4.0, ASR 3.7.0, DelayedWETH 1.5.0, PDG 2.2.0). SystemConfig and DGF resolve to the standard Sepolia impl addresses byte-for-byte.

### Notes for the reviewer

- **Own SuperchainConfig, as expected for a non-governed chain.** The chain uses its own `SuperchainConfig` (`0x11854D31…`) and its own v6.0.0 OPCM instance (`0xe259c6ea…`) rather than the Sepolia superchain's. Both are canonical v6.0.0 — the `SuperchainConfig` proxies to the standard `0xb08cc720…` implementation.
- **Impl addresses that differ from the standard table.** Portal, ASR, DelayedWETH, PreimageOracle and MIPS sit on non-standard implementations purely because their constructor args carry testnet-length windows (proof maturity 15 min, finality delay 5 min, withdrawal delay 10 min, challenge period 5 min). Every contract whose args weren't overridden — SystemConfig, DisputeGameFactory, SuperchainConfig — lands on the standard v6.0.0 impl byte-for-byte.
- **Prestate.** `gameArgs(1)` registers the generic op-program 1.3.1 cannon32 prestate, which predates this chain and can't prove it. Fine for a permissioned game; needs a custom prestate before any permissionless game type is enabled.
- **Filename.** Staged as `wch-sepolia.toml` because `check_chainlist` compares the staged filename against the ethereum-lists `shortName` (`wch-sepolia`). If you'd prefer `whitechain.toml` at promotion (→ `--network whitechain-sepolia`), please rename then.

topPRs.title: ops: carry post-Isthmus/Jovian genesis system config params
topPRs.author: donoso-eth
topPRs.body:
Closes #1398

## What

`[genesis.system_config]` can't express `minBaseFee` or the other post-Isthmus genesis params. For a Jovian-at-genesis chain with a non-zero floor, a node started from the registry builds genesis+1 with a `0` floor and diverges — see #1398 for the on-chain evidence.

## Changes

- `config.SystemConfig`: add `operatorFeeScalar`, `operatorFeeConstant`, `minBaseFee`, `daFootprintGasScalar` as optional keys. Names match kona's `SystemConfig`, which already models all four.
- `create-config` carries them from `rollup.Genesis.SystemConfig`, recorded only when non-zero (absent and zero are equivalent downstream).
- Docs: the new keys in the custom-chain template.

## Verification

- `apply_hardforks` rewrites all 55 shipped configs through the new struct: byte-identical, `git status` clean.
- New tests: fields round-trip when set and are omitted when unset; `create-config` carries non-zero values and skips zeros.

## Sequencing

Safe to merge alone — no shipped config sets the new keys. A config that does must not be promoted until the monorepo models them (`op-core` `SystemConfig` + `LoadOPStackRollupConfig`), or `TestAllEmbeddedConfigsDecodeStrictly` fails the next pin bump. Monorepo PR to follow.

## Recommended follow-up

Staged configs are decoded leniently, which is why a `minBaseFee` key passes `sync_staging --check` with `validation successful` and would be dropped at promotion. Downstream consumers (op-core, kona) all decode strictly. Rejecting unknown keys at staging time would catch the next unmodeled field or typo before it ships; kept out of this PR to keep it to the fix.
